_comment: Text for the flyer library (/member-resources/printables/). Branch flyers are made for every file in src/content/branches/ using the `branch` template; {name}, {area} and {meets} come from the branch file. After editing, run `npm run printables` with `npm run dev` going to rebuild the files.

chapter.title: Join the chapter
chapter.headline: Build power where you live.
chapter.body: We're working people organizing across the Sierra foothills for affordable housing, healthcare for all, and an economy that works for everyone. No experience needed.

branch.title: {name} branch
branch.headline: Organize with your neighbors.
branch.body: For people in {area}. Meet other members and help decide what we take on next.
branch._qrLabel: The address printed under the QR code. Shorter than the branch page's own address so it fits; it lists every branch.

_join: Ready-made 'join us' flyers: no fill-in boxes, a big QR code to the chapter sign-up form. Each one is made in every size. Add, remove, or reword them here; `id` becomes the file name.

join.title: Join us
join.headline: Join us.
join.body: We're working people across Placer, Nevada, El Dorado, and Sierra counties, organizing for a fairer economy and a real democracy. No experience needed. Come as you are.

join.title: Fed up? Get organized.
join.headline: Fed up? Get organized.
join.body: Rent, healthcare, wages: the problems are big, but there are a lot of us. Join neighbors across the Sierra foothills who are organizing to fix them.

join.title: You don't have to fight alone
join.headline: You don't have to fight alone.
join.body: When working people stick together, we win things none of us could win alone. Find your people in the foothills.

join.title: Socialists live here too
join.headline: Socialists live here too.
join.body: Yes, even in the foothills. We're your neighbors, coworkers, and friends, building a better future together. There's a place for you.

_ready: Ready-made printables with nothing to fill in. Most of their text comes from other files: member-guide.json (democratic socialism, community standards), glossary.json, quotes.json, and working-groups.json.

tableSign.title: Table sign
tableSign.blurb: Stand it up on your table so people know who you are.
tableSign.headline: Talk to a socialist.
tableSign.sub: Ask us anything. Then come organize with your neighbors.

handout.title: What is democratic socialism?
handout.blurb: A short handout for people who are curious. Two per sheet.

signIn.title: Sign-in sheet
signIn.blurb: For tables and events, so you can follow up with the people you meet.
signIn.headline: Stay in touch.
signIn.intro: Leave your info and someone from the chapter will follow up.
signIn.phoneCta: Rather sign up on your phone?

standards.title: Community standards poster
standards.blurb: Put it up at meetings so everyone knows what we expect of each other.

quotes.title: Quote cards
quotes.blurb: Square images to share, one quote each.

howTo: Open the PDF in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), Adobe Acrobat Reader, or Preview on a Mac.
Click a line under "Our next event" and type. On half-page and quarter-page sheets, every copy on the sheet updates at once.
Print at actual size (100%) on plain letter paper. Cut along the dashed lines.
Leave the boxes empty to write details in by hand.
rules: These flyers are for chapter and branch events. Keep the fill-in boxes to event details: date, time, place, and a short note.
Don't use them to speak for the chapter on endorsements, positions, or anything the chapter hasn't decided. Ask in Slack or email the chapter first.
Need something different, like a campaign flyer or a new design? Ask in Slack or email the chapter.
